etymology.historical_story: The spelling wu cannot establish a single word history. Romanization represents sounds with Latin letters, and Chinese names provide one documented setting in which Wu occurs. Without the original characters or a source sentence, however, its identity remains uncertain. A name appearing in Malay writing does not automatically become an ordinary Malay vocabulary item.
